title: Skills
description: Gives agents custom skills: instructions for one kind of task, in the SKILL.md format.
Enter skills in the node, or point it at a folder of skills in your RocketRide files.
The agent sees each skill's name and description, and loads the full instructions only for the skill it needs.

tool_skills.folder.title: Skills folder
tool_skills.folder.description: Folder in your RocketRide files that holds skills: one subfolder per skill, each with a SKILL.md. Example: skills. Leave empty to use only the skills entered below.

tool_skills.skillName.title: Name
tool_skills.skillName.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, for example release-notes. Leave empty to use the name in the SKILL.md frontmatter.

tool_skills.skillDescription.title: Description
tool_skills.skillDescription.description: What the skill does and when to use it. The agent reads this to decide whether to load the skill. Leave empty to use the description in the SKILL.md frontmatter.

tool_skills.skillInstructions.title: Instructions
tool_skills.skillInstructions.description: The skill's instructions in markdown, or a whole SKILL.md including its frontmatter.

tool_skills.skills.title: Skills
tool_skills.skills.description: Skills to give the agent. Paste a whole SKILL.md into Instructions, or fill in the name and description and write the instructions.
